title: RSSB Female Supervisor Admit Card 2026
vacancyDetails: 72 Female Supervisor (Mahila Paryavekshak) posts in Women & Child Development Department
qualification: As per RSSB Female Supervisor Advt (degree / eligibility as notified)
applicationFee: As per RSSB OTR / application fee rules
documentsRequired: Application number, DOB, security PIN; printed admit card; photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://rssb.rajasthan.gov.in
2. Open Admit Card section → Supervisor (Woman) 2026
3. Login via SSO / application credentials
4. Download hall ticket for 24 July exam
5. Carry printout and original ID
shortDescription: RSSB Female Supervisor Admit Card 2026 (exam 24 July). Form Correction window: 31 July – 06 August 2026 (72 posts).
content:
Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has released the Female Supervisor / Mahila Supervisor Admit Card 2026 for the written exam on 24 July 2026.

Total vacancies: 72 under Women & Child Development. Admit card download from rssb.rajasthan.gov.in / SSO.

Update: Application Correction Form window is from 31 July 2026 to 06 August 2026 (Correction charge ₹300). Full details: RSSB Female Supervisor 2026 post.
